ValidationRule.description: Stops users editing an Opportunity that was already Closed Won or Closed Lost before the edit, including changing its Stage to reopen it. Moving an open Opportunity to Closed is still allowed. Exceptions: users with the Edit Closed Opportunities custom permission (Beacon Salesforce Admin - Object, Tab, FLS), and saves that change one of the fields the Closed Won automation maintains (Closed Won Automation Complete, Closed Won Automation Error, Renewal Opportunity, Contract, License Start Date, License End Date), so the automation can finish after Closed Won. Honors the On/Off Switch (Run Validation Rules).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: $Setup.On_Off_Switch__c.Run_Validation_Rules__c && ( TEXT(PRIORVALUE(StageName)) = "Closed Won" || TEXT(PRIORVALUE(StageName)) = "Closed Lost" ) && NOT($Permission.Edit_Closed_Opportunities) && NOT( ISCHANGED(Closed_Won_Automation_Complete__c) || ISCHANGED(Closed_Won_Automation_Error__c) || ISCHANGED(Renewal_Opportunity__c) || ISCHANGED(ContractId) || ISCHANGED(License_Start_Date__c) || ISCHANGED(License_End_Date__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This Opportunity is closed and can't be edited. Contact a Beacon Salesforce Admin if it needs to be changed.
